title: ENTITY SCALE
description: Adjust the scale of EVERY ENTITY from 0.05x to 32.0x.
body:
**_IMPORTANT: IF YOU WANT TO PLAY THIS MOD IN SERVER, YOU MUST APPLY "Fabric API" MOD TO YOUR SERVER FIRST._**


Scale is a **Fabric mod that allows you to adjust the size of literally every entity in Minecraft.**

**From tiny 0.05x creatures to massive 32.0x giants, everything can be resized — including players, mobs, and projectiles, etc.**

---

⚙️ Features

• **Adjust the scale of all entities globally**  
• **Works on players, mobs, and even projectiles**  
• **Fully synchronized between server and client**  
• **Supports values from 0.05x up to 32.0x**  

---

🕹️ Commands

/scale current  
**→ Displays the current entity scale.**

/scale set <number>  
**→ Sets the scale for every entity (0.05x – 32.0x).**

/scale reset  
**→ Resets all entities to their default scale.**

---

🎮 Compatibility

**• Minecraft 1.21.1**  
**• Fabric Loader 0.15+**  
**• Java 21**
